what_this_is: Pipeline smoke test on a small stand-in model. It proves the DPO+NLL path EXECUTES and that rpo_alpha is what switches it on. It is NOT an efficacy result and says nothing about whether DPO improves any model.
why_this_model: Stand-in only: llama-style projection names, so config.py's existing target_modules apply unchanged. Run 1 must still use the real base under a signed prereg.

harness.gate_line: [gate] verified receipt OK - dpo_pairs_capped.jsonl (918 pairs); 0 violations, hashes match

claim_under_test: TRL 0.12.2 executes its NLL branch only when rpo_alpha is set; unset (the default) yields vanilla DPO. Source: dpo_trainer.py:1291-1299 computes nll_loss, :1337-1338 adds rpo_alpha*nll_loss, :1355-1356 logs it.

control_rpo_alpha_none.note: Identical run from a temporary copy of train_native.py with rpo_alpha=None; copy deleted afterwards.

verdict.additivity_check: loss == dpo_loss + rpo_alpha*nll_loss. step 5: 0.6914+0.4036=1.0950 vs observed 1.0959. step 10: 0.6762+0.3981=1.0743 vs observed 1.0720. Agreement to ~1e-3; the residual is batch-level variation between the two runs, not a discrepancy in the formula.
verdict.prepare_model_for_kbit_training_on_unqua: Ran without error on this model. Flagged in advance as a likely failure; it did not occur. Not evidence that it is correct in general - the real base is a bnb-4bit repo, which is the intended path.

what_this_does_not_show: That DPO+NLL improves any model. No held-out evaluation was run.
Anything about the real 8B base model, whose tokenizer and capability differ.
Any pass@k movement. eval.py was not invoked.
That the export path works - export_adapter.py still does not exist.
